csv_project_name: AE for Accessory Dwelling Units ADUS
csv_scope_of_work: The City is seeking Qualification Statements from interested Firms registered in the State of Florida to provide professional designs for Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) to be featured on the City of Orlando website. The goal is to provide a library of pre-designed ADU plans to ease the design process for property owners and encourage ADUs within allowable zoning districts. Interested parties will be able to contact firms directly to select the design and enter into a purchase contract. All designs provided must be compatible with the existing primary structure, the surrounding neighborhood, and all applicable building and maintenance codes. Respondents are also encouraged to submit designs for ADUs that will: Feature innovative ways to reduce initial building costs and future maintenance costs. Provide a long-lasting, durable and leak-free exterior building envelope Provide higher quality interior air quality Reduce long term operating costs Address the additional design goals/requirements described in Accessory Dwelling Units Design Guidelines and Requirements below.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Planning/Master Planning

title: AE for Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)
short_description: Design services for a library of pre-designed accessory dwelling units in Orlando.
project_scope: Professional design of accessory dwelling units (ADUs) for publication on the City of Orlando website as a library of pre-designed plans. Designs must be compatible with existing primary structures, surrounding neighborhoods, zoning districts, and applicable building and maintenance codes. The brief encourages innovative solutions to reduce initial construction and maintenance costs, provide durable and leak-free building envelopes, improve indoor air quality, and reduce long-term operating costs.
services: Architecture services, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, cost estimating, and planning/master planning; preparation of pre-designed ADU plans.
relevance_explanation:
- Small-scale residential building designs with no indication of complex or innovative structural systems.
- Focus is primarily architectural and planning-oriented rather than structural engineering.
- No long spans, bridges, special structures, sports facilities, or large/complex buildings.
- Could include some civil engineering input, but overall fit with sbp's core profile is low.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The tender concerns preparation of prototype ADU designs rather than a specific building project. Useful cost-related information: small residential accessory dwelling units, emphasis on reducing initial and lifecycle costs, but no unit sizes, quantities, or target budgets are provided.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source. The procurement is for qualification statements for design services for multiple pre-designed ADU concepts, with no stated contract value, fee basis, or expected scope per selected firm.
references_qualifications: Firms must be registered in the State of Florida. The notice seeks qualification statements from interested firms for professional ADU designs. No specific minimum reference projects or quantitative qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
